review_candidates.title: District Lead - TB
review_candidates.job_function: General Business, Management, and Business Development
review_candidates.description: Overview WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions. As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors. Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale. WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri – Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels. Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country. WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values. Program Overview The World Health Organization estimated that 10.6 million people fell ill with tuberculosis (TB) in 2022 and ~1.3 million succumbed to it. India accounted for the most people suffering from the disease, with 27% of the cases and 26% of mortality. The National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), headed by the Central TB Division (CTD), MoHFW, is an expansive public health program with the ambitious goal of eliminating TB in line with the mandate of the Sustainable Development Goals. WJCF has been supporting the CTD and state health departments of more than 15 states in the mission to eliminate TB. WJCF’s TB program has been operational since 2012, and its interventions address several program areas, including preventive therapies, case detection, access to diagnostics, engagement of the private sector, and more. It also lends technical support to Governments across a range of themes- strategic planning, data analytics, monitoring and evaluation, patient management and delivery of services. WJCF’s current portfolio of work spans support includes an evaluation of the TB drugs demand and supply dynamics, a landscape assessment for the next generation of diagnostic methods, a high-powered multi-disciplinary team translating programmatic information into action, and multiple large-scale interventions to determine the best methods for detecting hidden TB in the community. About The Project India carries the world’s largest tuberculosis burden, 26% of global cases and 26% of TB mortality in 2023. The National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), led by the Central TB Division (CTD) under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, is committed to eliminating TB in line with National and Sustainable Development Goals targets. The private sector accounts for over 50% of TB patients seeking care in India yet contributes a disproportionately small share of household contact screening and TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) initiation. WJCF is implementing a new project, “Expanding TPT in the Private Sector at the Patient’s Doorstep” across four districts: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) and Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) in Gujarat, and Faridabad and Gurgaon in Haryana. The project will establish TPT Centres within high-load private multi-specialty hospitals and standalone clinics and operationalize a “Coordinated Services Delivery at Doorstep” model through third-party agency partnerships. The model integrates: index patient identification and household contact enumeration; TB infection (TBI/IGRA) testing and chest X-ray screening; TPT initiation; and doorstep drug delivery with adherence follow-up – all documented on Nikshay. Key project targets include at least 40 high-load private facilities with functional TPT Centres across four districts; a three-fold increase in household contacts initiated on TPT through the private sector and a fully documented and costed Coordinated Services Delivery model to NTEP and State TB Cells for adoption through the existing PPSA/PPM financing framework. Position Summary WJCF is recruiting four District Leads for this project, one each for Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) and Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) in Gujarat, and one each for Faridabad and Gurgaon in Haryana. Each District Lead will be the operational lead for project implementation within their assigned district, reporting to the State Lead for their geography. The District Lead is the day-to-day programme manager at the district level, running TPT Centre establishment, supervising Field Officers and Telecallers on the ground, managing all facility-level and DTC relationships, coordinating third-party agency service delivery, and ensuring that every household contact in an intervention facility moves through the TPT cascade and is documented on Nikshay. This is a predominantly field-based role requiring approximately 60% local travel. The District Lead must be able to build and sustain the District and Facility relationships actively redirect field energy toward the prevention cascade. Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? Do you crave the freedom, power, and support to bring fresh ideas to how work is delivered, so client expectations are not just met, but smashed? Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is quite real! Read on! ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects! If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. ) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested - we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself - your relationship with yourself Care about people - your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness - your relationship with your team Build civilisation - your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role Supercharge client service: Deliver cutting-edge cost management powered by digital tools, moving beyond static reporting to dynamic project insight. Cradle-to-grave expertise: Oversee every commercial aspect of projects, from initial concepts through close-out. Champion collaboration: Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, particularly with project managers, planners and design teams, to ensure timely, on-budget, and high-quality project deliver. Innovate fearlessly: Bring fresh ideas to the table, design new processes, and exceed industry expectations with progressive thinking. Embrace digital transformation: Lead the integration of project management elements through Laminar's project controls-centric delivery, streamlining workflow and maximising control. Think outside spreadsheets: We aren't looking for Excel-only users. We want professionals who embrace a digitally enhanced approach to cost management. Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on: Understanding what the real problems of projects are. Implementing the best solutions to those problems. Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology. More specifically you will be part of our Commercial Services Team. Your leader will be our Commercial Director. Your top three objectives: To make construction projects deliver to near perfection To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems To develop yourself and everyone around you Your top five responsibilities: Own the cost : Manage the project costs through all stage gates, integrating QCRA and risk-adjusted forecasting to provide a "no surprises" financial environment. Own the outcome : Lead pre-construction estimating and post-contract live cost management. This includes managing complex change orders with deep-dive cost analysis to protect the client’s interests. Report and inform : Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively (Laminar’s existing infrastructure will support this). Make scalable solutions : Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved Develop everyone : Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well. Your capabilities: You will be a seasoned Cost Engineer, with extensive experience working directly with clients, ideally with some stints working for Tier 1 or 2 Contractors as well, to provide the well-rounded experience that is hugely valuable as a consultant. You understand that cost does not live in a vacuum - it is a byproduct of schedule, risk, and scope. You must have: Mastery : Cost Management background with at least 5+ years of experience on construction projects Communication: Proficient in written and spoken English communication skills. Additional language abilities are appreciated, with Norwegian considered an advantage. Leadership : A relentless approach to dealing with people Impact : A track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics Location: experience working within the Nordic market and willingness to travel every other week to support our regional operations. Data Centre Focus (Desirable): Prior experience in Data Centres or high-tech industrial projects is highly valued. Proven ability to develop comprehensive commercial strategies for complex construction projects, encompassing budgeting, forecasting, risk management, and cost control, from initiation to close-out and handover. Demonstrated success in leading negotiations with clients, contractors, and stakeholders to secure optimal terms and favourable outcomes in fast-paced environments. Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximise your savings Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment The life-changing stuff: In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: Why you want to join us What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: DESCRIÇÃO SUMÁRIA Responsável por coordenar o setor de Engenharia e Redes da GBSNET, integrando a operação do NOC, a infraestrutura de campo e a gestão de projetos de rede sob uma única estrutura. Atua garantindo a resiliência e a estabilidade da rede no dia a dia e conduzindo projetos de melhoria e expansão do início ao fim, dentro dos prazos, escopo e orçamento definidos. Lidera a equipe técnica, estrutura processos e fluxos de trabalho e mantém a relação com áreas internas e fornecedores, assegurando entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos da diretoria. REPORTE E ESTRUTURA Reporta-se ao Head de Operações e CX. Coordena os analistas de NOC, os analistas de infraestrutura de campo e o time de projetos, contando com apoio técnico especializado (N3/N4) de consultoria parceira. RESPONSABILIDADES — Garantir a resiliência, a estabilidade e a disponibilidade da rede, atuando de forma estruturada sobre as ocorrências do dia a dia. — Coordenar e priorizar as demandas de operação e de projetos, equilibrando o atendimento contínuo com as entregas planejadas. — Conduzir projetos de rede (expansões, migrações e melhorias tecnológicas) do planejamento à entrega, cumprindo prazo, escopo e orçamento. — Desenhar, estruturar e manter processos, fluxos e indicadores do setor. — Liderar, desenvolver e cobrar a equipe técnica, conduzindo contratações e decisões de pessoal quando necessário. — Gerir a relação com fornecedores e com as áreas internas (clientes internos), assegurando alinhamento e qualidade das entregas. — Acompanhar indicadores de rede e de projetos, reportando resultados à diretoria. — Participar do comitê técnico de aprovação e priorização de projetos. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES FORMAÇÃO: Superior em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Elétrica, Administração ou áreas afins. EXPERIÊNCIA: Mínimo de 3 anos coordenando ou liderando equipes — com poder real de cobrar, contratar e desligar — e histórico comprovado de projetos entregues no prazo e no escopo (resultados demonstráveis, não apenas participação). GESTÃO: Domínio de gestão de projetos: planejamento, prazo, escopo e orçamento. DESEJÁVEL: Vivência em provedor de internet (ISP), NOC ou infraestrutura de rede — não obrigatória, podendo ser substituída por um histórico forte de entrega em outro setor. Conhecimento técnico de redes também é desejável e não obrigatório: o setor conta com apoio especializado N3/N4 da consultoria parceira.

Monitor consultant performance against contractual obligations, reporting requirements, and KPIs. Post-Contract Cost Control Monitor project costs against approved budgets and business plans. Review and consolidate forecasts, cash flows, and financial reports. Identify commercial risks and opportunities, implementing proactive mitigation strategies. Maintain oversight of commitments, expenditures, and cost-to-complete forecasts. Contract Administration & Claims Management Support the administration of FIDIC-based contracts. Oversee commercial aspects relating to: Variations and change control Payment certifications Claims and extensions of time Provide commercial input on contractual correspondence and key notices. Ensure all changes are commercially justified, documented, and appropriately managed. Review entitlement, quantum, and contractual compliance of claims. Assess the cost implications of design changes, value engineering initiatives, and scope adjustments. Identify and mitigate commercial risks throughout project delivery. Financial Reporting & Stakeholder Management Prepare and present commercial and financial reports to senior management. Provide insight into project financial performance, risks, and forecasts. Collaborate with development, design, finance, legal, procurement, and project management teams. Manage relationships with consultants, contractors, authorities, and external stakeholders. Proven experience managing external cost consultants and commercial advisors. Extensive knowledge of FIDIC contracts and commercial administration. Strong background in claims management, variations, change control, and final account negotiations. Experience within European construction environments is highly desirable. Familiarity with EU procurement and regulatory requirements is an advantage. Key Competencies: Strong commercial leadership and strategic thinking. Excellent understanding of commercial processes and contract mechanisms. Strong financial and analytical skills. Ability to challenge consultants and contractors constructively. Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and detailed levels. Strong communication, reporting, and presentation skills. Experience engaging with regulatory authorities and overseeing commercial aspects of approvals and compliance requirements. What We're Looking For: We are seeking a professional who can combine: Commercial Leadership + Cost Governance + Contractual Expertise + Risk Management + Consultant Management This role is ideal for a commercially astute professional who can provide strategic oversight, drive value, manage risk, and ensure successful commercial outcomes across complex development projects.

Suas Responsabilidades no Dia a Dia: Recebimento e Estoque: Receber, conferir e organizar as mercadorias de forma eficiente, mantendo o estoque em ordem. Preparação de Pedidos: Realizar triagem, etiquetagem e embalagem (packing) seguindo os padrões exigidos pelos marketplaces. Expedição: Separar itens (picking) e organizar os pacotes para coleta das transportadoras. Suporte Operacional: Auxiliar no atendimento e no recebimento de pedidos nos canais de comunicação, garantindo agilidade e boa comunicação com clientes e parceiros. Requisitos e Qualificações: Ensino Médio completo. Facilidade para trabalhos manuais com atenção a detalhes (conferência de códigos, bipagem e embalagem). Disposição para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e focado em metas diárias de envio. Organização, pontualidade e trabalho em equipe. Boa comunicação para o atendimento nos canais. Diferenciais: Cursando Técnico ou Superior em Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia em expedição, estoque ou galpão logístico. Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Excel, Word) e f amiliaridade com sistemas e ferramentas digitais. O que oferecemos: Salário: R$ 1977,00 / mês Regime de Contratação: CLT  Jornada: 44h semanais – Segunda a Sexta-feira, das 08h00 às 17h48 (1h de almoço) Benefícios: Vale-Transporte Local de Trabalho: Presencial – Residencial Estoril (Próximo ao Shopping Via Vale Garden)

review_candidates.title: Associate - Project & Ops (Investment)
review_candidates.description: Location: Jakarta (Remote) About the XA Network XA Network is an exclusive community of senior tech executives and founders, headquartered in Singapore with chapters in Southeast Asia and Australia. For more information, please visit www.xanetwork.co. The Offer Own the Engine Behind INVEST: Build and run the systems, data, and processes that power XA's investment pipeline — with direct impact on deal velocity, member allocation, and portfolio visibility. Senior Exposure: Work closely with XA's investment leadership, founders, and members across Southeast Asia and Australia, gaining unique exposure to high-calibre operators and investors. Flexible, High-Trust Culture: Enjoy remote-only work and a high-performance culture inspired by leading global technology companies. The Job As Investment Operations & Projects Associate, you will be the operational backbone of XA Network's INVEST pillar. Rather than sourcing or evaluating deals yourself, you will build and maintain the pipeline infrastructure, reporting, and processes that let us move faster and make better-informed decisions. You will own the Airtable pipeline end-to-end, prepare investment-related documentation, coordinate stakeholders between founders and members, and lead projects that improve how the INVEST pillar operates — from automating manual steps to building dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health and portfolio activity. This role is ideal for someone with a product mindset who wants exposure to investment operations without requiring a deal-execution background. Key Responsibilities Pipeline & Investment Operations Own and maintain the deal pipeline on Airtable, ensuring data accuracy, timely updates, and clean handoffs between stages. Manage investment-related documents (e.g. term sheets, data room materials, investment memos) in coordination with the investment team. Support stakeholder management between founders and members, coordinating diligence requests, scheduling, and follow-ups. Projects & Change Scope, plan, and manage projects that productize the INVEST pillar systems and processes, from initiation through implementation. Identify and automate manual or repetitive steps in the deal and reporting workflow, escalating technical build needs where required. Maintain and refine process documentation and playbooks so the pipeline scales as deal volume and team size grow. Reporting & Visibility Build and maintain dashboards tracking pipeline health, allocation, and portfolio activity for Leadership Team reporting. Query and visualise deal and member data to surface trends and support investment decision-making. The Profile You have at least 2 years of experience in an operations, product, or investment-support role; direct deal experience is a plus but not required. You have demonstrated experience delivering operational improvement projects or managing change in a fast-moving environment. Exceptional organisational skills, superb attention to detail, and timely responsiveness to requests are a must. You can prioritise and multitask across concurrent deals and projects while maintaining a commitment to deadlines. You are comfortable working with databases and able to query and visualise data for analytical and reporting purposes. You are comfortable working with and picking up digital platforms, including GSuite, Airtable, Zapier, and PandaDoc. You are AI-native, with strong comfort building dashboards, integrations, automations, and reports using tools such as Claude Cowork, Codex, Qwen, or Gemini. You have the professional polish, including high-quality written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to demonstrate grace and composure under pressure. Professional English is a non-negotiable. Integrity and discretion in handling confidential information. The Process 30-min interview -> followed by a take-home case study (with your AI tool of choice and our Airtable database) + 30-min walkthrough -> a final interview.
